        .adv-name {
          flex: 1; min-width: 0;
          font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--mono);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }
        .adv-name small {
          display: block; margin-top: 2px;
          color: var(--muted); font: 400 10.5px/1.4 var(--sans);
        }
        .adv-input {
          flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
          height: 34px; padding: 0 8px;
          border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
          background: var(--panel-2);
        }
        .adv-input:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); }
        .adv-input input {
          width: 62px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent;
          color: var(--ink); outline: none;
          font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono); text-align: right;
          -moz-appearance: textfield; appearance: textfield;
        }
        .adv-input input.wide { width: 110px; text-align: left; }
        .adv-input input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,
        .adv-input input::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }
        .adv-input span {
          font: 500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);
          letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
          color: var(--faint);
        }
        .adv-ro {
          flex: none; max-width: 46%; text-align: right;
          font: 500 10.5px/1.4 var(--mono); color: var(--muted);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }
      
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           Buttons
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        /* The window's button: a raised paper face with a real edge, the accent for
           the one action that matters, and a press that moves. Hit areas stay at
           44px because this one is under a thumb, not a mouse. */
        .btn {
          -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
          height: 44px; padding: 0 15px;
          display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px;
          border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
          background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink);
          font: 600 12.5px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: .005em;
          box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23, 24, 15, .08), var(--panel-shadow);
          transition: background .18s var(--ease), color .18s var(--ease),
                      border-color .18s var(--ease), transform .12s var(--ease),
                      box-shadow .12s var(--ease);
        }
        .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; }
        .btn:disabled { opacity: .4; }
        .btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: none; }
      
        .btn.solid {
          background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent);
          box-shadow: none;
        }
        .btn.solid:active { background: var(--accent-press); border-color: var(--accent-press); }
        .btn.outline { border-color: var(--rule-strong); }
        .btn.quiet {
          border-color: transparent; background: none; box-shadow: none;
          color: var(--muted); padding: 0 10px;
        }
        .btn.quiet.danger { color: var(--bad); }
        .btn.small { height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 11.5px; }
      
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           Dock
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        .dock {
          position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 20;
          display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
          padding: 10px 14px calc(10px + var(--safe-bottom));
          background: var(--panel);
          border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
          box-shadow: 0 -10px 28px -24px rgba(23, 24, 15, .55);
        }
        @supports ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px))) {
          .dock {
            background: rgba(247, 243, 232, .9);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(120%);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(120%);
          }
          @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
            .dock { background: rgba(25, 27, 22, .9); }
          }
        }
        .dock .btn.solid { flex: 1; min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; }
      
        .progress {
          position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 2px;
          z-index: 40; overflow: hidden;
        }
        .progress[hidden] { display: none; }
        .progress::after {
          content: ""; display: block; height: 100%; width: 28%;
          background: var(--accent);
          animation: indeterminate 1.1s var(--ease) infinite;
        }
      
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           Snackbar + reset sheet
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        .snackbar {
          position: fixed; left: 14px; right: 14px;
          bottom: calc(78px + var(--safe-bottom));
          z-index: 30;
          padding: 12px 14px;
          border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
          background: var(--console); color: var(--console-ink);
          font: 500 11.5px/1.5 var(--mono);
          box-shadow: var(--shadow);
          opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); pointer-events: none;
          transition: opacity .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease);
        }
        .snackbar.show { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
        .snackbar[data-tone="ok"] { border-left-color: var(--ok); }
        .snackbar[data-tone="error"] {
          border-left-color: var(--bad);
          background: var(--bad); color: var(--paper);
        }
      
        dialog.sheet {
          width: min(420px, calc(100% - 28px));
          margin: auto auto calc(14px + var(--safe-bottom)); padding: 0;
          border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: 14px;
          background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink);
          box-shadow: 0 32px 64px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, .65);
        }
        dialog.sheet::backdrop { background: rgba(10, 10, 8, .55); }
        .sheet-inner { padding: 22px; }
        .sheet h2 {
          margin: 0 0 8px;
          font: 700 19px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -.02em;
        }
        .sheet p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; }
        .sheet-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; }
      
        /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
           Fit + feel
           --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        @media (max-width: 380px) {
          body { padding-left: 15px; padding-right: 15px; }
          .phone { width: 78px; height: 138px; }
          .hero-value { font-size: clamp(46px, 15vw, 60px); }
          .dock { gap: 4px; padding-left: 10px; padding-right: 10px; }
          .dock .btn { padding: 0 10px; font-size: 12px; }
          .dock .btn.quiet { padding: 0 6px; }
          .dock .btn.solid svg { display: none; }
          .number { padding: 0 7px; }
          .number input { width: 36px; }
        }
      
        @media (max-width: 340px) {
          .readout-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
          .preview { display: none; }
        }
      
        @media (min-width: 560px) {
          .dock {
            left: 50%; right: auto; width: 640px; max-width: 100%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            padding-left: 18px; padding-right: 18px;
            border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--rule);
          }
          .dock .btn.quiet { margin-right: auto; }
          .dock .btn.solid { flex: 0 0 250px; }
          .snackbar { left: 50%; right: auto; width: 560px; transform: translate(-50%, 8px); }
          .snackbar.show { transform: translate(-50%, 0); }
        }
      
        @media (min-width: 680px) {
          body { padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0; }
        }
      
        :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
        .range:focus-visible { outline-offset: 4px; }
      
        @media (hover: hover) {
          .icon-button:hover { background: var(--panel-2); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
          .btn:hover:not(.quiet):not(.solid) { background: var(--panel-2); }
          .btn.outline:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
          .btn.quiet:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--ink); }
          .btn.solid:hover { background: var(--accent-press); border-color: var(--accent-press); }
          .diag summary:hover .chevron { color: var(--ink); }
        }
      
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        @keyframes indeterminate {
          0% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
          100% { transform: translateX(400%); }
        }
        @keyframes rise {
          from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(7px); }
          to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
        }
        @keyframes scan {
          0% { transform: translateY(-140%); }
          100% { transform: translateY(330%); }
        }
      
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
          .masthead-row { animation: rise .45s var(--ease) both; }
          .title { animation: rise .5s .04s var(--ease) both; }
          .device { animation: rise .5s .08s var(--ease) both; }
          .chips { animation: rise .5s .12s var(--ease) both; }
          .readout { animation: rise .55s .16s var(--ease) both; }
          .card { animation: rise .55s .2s var(--ease) both; }
          .diag { animation: rise .55s .24s var(--ease) both; }
          .phone::after { animation: scan 8s linear infinite; }
        }
      
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
          *, *::before, *::after {
            animation-duration: .01ms !important;
            animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
            transition-duration: .01ms !important;
          }
          .phone::after { display: none; }
        }
      </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="progress" id="progress" hidden></div>
      
        <header class="masthead">
          <div class="masthead-row">
            <p class="kicker"><span class="kicker-mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>Treble / runtime overlay</p>
            <button class="icon-button" id="refreshBtn" type="button" aria-label="Refresh">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                   stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                <path d="M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2.3 5.7"></path>
                <path d="M20 5v6h-6"></path>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
      
          <h1 class="title">Overlay<span class="title-tag" aria-hidden="true">UI</span></h1>
          <p class="device" id="deviceLine">Connecting to the device…</p>
      
          <div class="chips">
            <span class="chip" id="chipApi" data-tone="neutral">
              <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="label">Android —</span>
            </span>
            <span class="chip" id="chipOverlay" data-tone="neutral">
              <span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span class="label">Checking overlays</span>
            </span>
          </div>
      
          <div class="banner" id="banner" hidden>
            <strong id="bannerTitle">Root shell unavailable</strong>
            <span id="bannerText"></span>
            <code id="bannerDetail"></code>
          </div>
        </header>
      
        <main>
          <section class="readout" aria-labelledby="heroLabel">
            <div class="readout-grid">
              <div>
                <p class="eyebrow" id="heroLabel"><span class="idx">01</span>Corner radius</p>
                <p class="hero-value"><span id="heroNum">—</span><span class="unit">px</span></p>
                <p class="hero-note" id="heroNote">Rounded screen corners</p>
              </div>
              <div class="preview" aria-hidden="true">
                <div class="phone" id="device">
                  <div class="device-bar"><span class="pill"></span><span class="dot"></span><span class="dot"></span></div>
                  <div class="device-body">
                    <i class="strong"></i><i></i><i style="width:84%"></i><i style="width:62%"></i>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
      
            <div class="readout-controls">
              <div class="range-wrap">
                <input class="range" type="range" id="s-RADIUS" min="0" max="240" step="1"
                       aria-label="Corner radius">
              </div>
              <div class="number">
                <input type="number" id="RADIUS" inputmode="numeric" min="0" max="240"
                       aria-label="Corner radius in pixels">
                <span>px</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </section>
      
          <section class="card" id="frameworkCard">
            <div class="card-head">
              <h2><span class="idx">02</span>Framework</h2>
              <span class="meta">android</span>
            </div>
            <div id="rows-framework"></div>
          </section>
      
          <section class="card" id="systemuiCard">
            <div class="card-head">
              <h2><span class="idx">03</span>Status bar</h2>
              <span class="meta">systemui</span>
            </div>
            <div id="rows-systemui"></div>
          </section>
      
          <section class="card">
            <div class="card-head">
              <h2><span class="idx">04</span>Power</h2>
              <span class="meta">doze</span>
            </div>
            <div class="switch-row">
              <label class="row-label" for="DOZE_BLANK">
                Blank after doze
                <small>config_displayBlanksAfterDoze</small>
              </label>
              <span class="active" id="cur-DOZE_BLANK">—</span>
              <label class="switch">
                <input type="checkbox" id="DOZE_BLANK">
                <span class="track"></span><span class="thumb"></span>
              </label>
            </div>
          </section>
      
          <!-- Module addons, both kinds: a live pick is a Settings value the module
               writes itself and applies the moment it is made (and again on every
               boot); an overlay pick is a resource, written into the installed APK
               by Apply together with the sliders. -->
          <section class="card" id="addonsCard">
            <div class="card-head">
              <h2><span class="idx">05</span>Addons</h2>
              <span class="meta">module</span>
            </div>
            <p class="adv-hint">
              These are module addons. A live pick is a Settings value the module
              writes itself: it applies as soon as you make it, and again on every
              boot so it sticks. An overlay pick is a resource in the APK this build
              shipped: Apply writes it into that APK (with the sliders), and a reload
              makes the framework read it. <b>Use default</b> removes an addon — the
              line leaves addons.conf and, for an overlay, the resource leaves the
              APK, so the ROM's own value is used again.
            </p>
            <div id="rows-addons" class="addon-rows"></div>
            <div class="addon-foot">
              <button class="btn quiet small" id="addonsResetBtn" type="button">Reset addons</button>
              <span class="addon-note" id="addonsNote"></span>
            </div>
          </section>
      
          <details class="diag" id="adv">
            <summary>
              <span>All resources</span>
              <span class="summary-meta" id="allResMeta" aria-hidden="true">manifest</span>
              <span class="chevron">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                     stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path>
                </svg>
              </span>
            </summary>
            <div class="diag-body">
              <p class="adv-hint" id="allResHint">
                Every other value this build writes, read from the module's
                <code>webui-manifest.json</code>. Changing one patches it into the overlay APK
                just like the sliders above. Values marked <em>rebuild</em> have no single value
                (arrays, landscape-only, resource references).
              </p>
              <div id="allGroups"></div>
            </div>
          </details>
      
          <details class="diag" id="diag">
            <summary>
              <span>Diagnostics</span>
              <span class="summary-meta" aria-hidden="true">shell</span>
              <span class="chevron">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"
                     stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                  <path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path>
                </svg>
              </span>
            </summary>
            <div class="diag-body">
              <pre class="log" id="log">Waiting for the device…</pre>
              <div class="diag-actions">
                <button class="btn outline small" id="statusBtn" type="button">Refresh status</button>
                <button class="btn quiet small" id="diagBtn" type="button">Run diagnostics</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </details>
        </main>
      
        <div class="snackbar" id="snackbar" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
      
        <div class="dock">
          <button class="btn quiet danger" id="resetBtn" type="button">Reset</button>
          <button class="btn outline" id="applyQuiet" type="button">Apply</button>
          <button class="btn solid" id="applyRestart" type="button">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2"
                 stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
              <path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path>
            </svg>
            Apply &amp; reload
          </button>
        </div>
      
        <dialog class="sheet" id="resetDialog">
          <div class="sheet-inner">
            <h2>Reset overrides?</h2>
            <p>Restores the overlay APKs this module shipped and discards the saved values. The framework restarts when something was actually applied; the build-time values come back with it.</p>
            <div class="sheet-actions">
              <button class="btn quiet" id="resetCancel" type="button" value="cancel">Cancel</button>
              <button class="btn solid" id="resetConfirm" type="button" value="confirm">Reset</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </dialog>
      
      <script>
      (function () {
        "use strict";
      
        /* -------------------------------------------------------------------
           Fields
           ------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        var FIELDS = [
          { key: "RADIUS",      group: "hero",      label: "Corner radius",
            hint: "Rounded screen corners",                     min: 0, max: 240, hero: true },
          { key: "SB_HEIGHT",   group: "framework", label: "Status bar height",
            hint: "Height of the bar above apps",               min: 0, max: 240 },
          { key: "PAD_CONTENT", group: "framework", label: "Content padding",
            hint: "Framework inset — many ROMs ignore it; set the pair below too",
                                                                min: 0, max: 160 },
          { key: "PAD_START",   group: "systemui",  label: "Padding start",
            hint: "Space before the clock",                     min: 0, max: 160 },
          { key: "PAD_END",     group: "systemui",  label: "Padding end",
            hint: "Space after the status icons",               min: 0, max: 160 }
        ];
      
        var STATUS_KEY = {
          RADIUS: "radius", SB_HEIGHT: "sb_height", PAD_CONTENT: "pad_content",
          PAD_START: "pad_start", PAD_END: "pad_end", DOZE_BLANK: "doze_blank"
        };
      
        var API_NAMES = { 31: "12", 32: "12L", 33: "13", 34: "14", 35: "15", 36: "16", 37: "17" };
      
        var el = {};
        FIELDS.forEach(function (f) {
          f.row = null;
          f.range = null;
          f.num = null;
          f.active = null;
        });
      
        var state = {
          fields: {},            // key -> { row, range, num, active }
          values: {},            // what the page would apply
          active: {},            // what the device resolves right now
          sdk: "",
          model: "",
          total: 0,
          enabled: 0,
          noBridge: false,
          uid: "",
          notRoot: false,
          useSu: false,
          suBin: "",
          blocked: false,
          rootProbe: null,
          rootTried: false,
          rootError: "",
          log: [],
          pinned: "",           // last failed Apply/Reset output, kept above the log
          saved: {},            // values from webui.conf (what Apply stored)
          pending: [],          // saved values the framework has not picked up yet
          notice: null,         // banner text that survives a status refresh
          manifest: null,       // webui-manifest.json: what the build wrote
          extra: {},            // "type/name" -> the value the page would write
          extraBase: {},        // "type/name" -> the value the build wrote
          extraNodes: {},       // "type/name" -> { row, input, unit }
          patched: 0,           // APKs that still carry a patch (from status)
          failed: false,        // the boot guard undid the last patch
          autoDone: false,      // the saved values were re-applied this session
          addons: null,         // addons.sh list: catalog, saved and live values
          addonPicks: {},       // id -> the value the card shows
          addonBase: {}         // id -> what the list read when it was loaded
        };
      
        function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
      
        /* -------------------------------------------------------------------
           Shell bridge
           KernelSU's native bridge does NOT take a JS function: it takes the
           *name* of a global callback and evaluates it later (this is what the
           official js/kernelsu library does). Other managers take a function, a
           promise, or return the result synchronously. Probe once, then use the
           convention that actually answers.
           ------------------------------------------------------------------- */
        function findBridge() {
          // KernelSU / KSU Next / APatch expose `ksu` (APatch deliberately keeps the
          // KernelSU name for compatibility). Magisk WebUI hosts use their own
          // globals: MMRL / WebUI X expose `mmrl` or `$mmrl`; KsuWebUI exposes
          // `ksu`; a few hosts use `webui`.
          var names = ["ksu", "Ksu", "$ksu", "apatch", "APatch",
                       "magisk", "Magisk", "$magisk",
                       "mmrl", "$mmrl", "MMRL", "$MMRL",
                       "webui", "$webui", "WebUI", "$WebUI"];
          for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
            var obj = window[names[i]];
            if (obj && typeof obj.exec === "function") {
              return { label: names[i], exec: obj.exec.bind(obj) };
            }
          }
          return null;
        }
      
        var bridge = findBridge();
        var bridgeMode = null;      // "name" | "name2" | "callback" | "twoArg" | "oneArg"
        var bridgeProbe = null;
        var CALLBACK_SEQ = 0;
      
        function normalizeResult(value) {
          if (value == null) return null;
          if (typeof value === "string") {
            try { value = JSON.parse(value); } catch (e) { return { errno: 0, stdout: String(value), stderr: "" }; }
          }
          if (typeof value === "object") {
            if (typeof value.stdout !== "undefined" || typeof value.errno !== "undefined") {
              return {
                errno: Number(typeof value.errno === "number" ? value.errno : 0),
                stdout: String(value.stdout == null ? "" : value.stdout),
                stderr: String(value.stderr == null ? "" : value.stderr)
              };
            }
            // Some managers nest the result in `data`.
            if (value.data && typeof value.data === "object") return normalizeResult(value.data);
          }
          return null;
        }
      
        function normalizeCallback(a, b, c) {
          if (typeof a === "number") {
            return { errno: a, stdout: String(b == null ? "" : b), stderr: String(c == null ? "" : c) };
          }
          if (typeof a === "string" && typeof b === "string") {
            // Some forks use callback(stdout, stderr).
            return { errno: 0, stdout: a, stderr: b };
          }
          var nested = normalizeResult(a);
          if (nested) return nested;
          if (typeof a === "string") return { errno: 0, stdout: a, stderr: "" };
          return null;
        }
      
        // Runs one command with one calling convention. Resolves to null when that
        // convention produced no reply (so the probe can try the next one).
        function callBridge(mode, cmd, timeoutMs) {
          return new Promise(function (resolve) {
            var settled = false;
            var timer = null;
            var callbackName = null;
      
            function finish(result) {
              if (settled) return;
              settled = true;
              if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
              if (callbackName) { try { delete window[callbackName]; } catch (e) {} }
              resolve(result || null);
            }
      
            timer = setTimeout(function () { finish(null); }, timeoutMs || 15000);
      
            var handler = function (a, b, c) { finish(normalizeCallback(a, b, c)); };
      
            try {
              var ret;
              if (mode === "name" || mode === "name2") {
                // KernelSU / APatch native: ksu.exec(cmd, options, callbackFunctionName)
                // Some minimal hosts expose the two-argument form only.
                callbackName = "__treble_webui_cb_" + Date.now().toString(36) + "_" + (++CALLBACK_SEQ);
                window[callbackName] = handler;
                ret = mode === "name"
                  ? bridge.exec(cmd, JSON.stringify({ cwd: "/" }), callbackName)
                  : bridge.exec(cmd, callbackName);
              } else if (mode === "oneArg") {
                // Old / minimal bridges: ksu.exec(cmd) returns stdout synchronously.
                ret = bridge.exec(cmd);
              } else if (mode === "twoArg") {
                ret = bridge.exec(cmd, handler);
              } else {
                ret = bridge.exec(cmd, JSON.stringify({ cwd: "/" }), handler);
              }

  content: |
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // index.html and app.js have to agree
      // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // The window is one page and one script with no framework and no bundler: a
      // rename in the HTML or a typo in the script is not caught by any compiler, and
      // the failure mode is a dead button and a console error only a devtools user
      // sees. Pulling the ids out of both files catches that in CI instead.
      //
      // Run: node --test stuff/tests/gui-ui.test.js
      import { test } from 'node:test';
      import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
      import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
      import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
      import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
      
      const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', '..');
      const html = readFileSync(join(root, 'gui', 'ui', 'index.html'), 'utf8');
      const js = readFileSync(join(root, 'gui', 'ui', 'app.js'), 'utf8');
      
      function idsInHtml() {
        const ids = new Set();
        for (const m of html.matchAll(/\bid="([^"]+)"/g)) ids.add(m[1]);
        return ids;
      }
      
      // $('x') and document.getElementById('x'). Anything computed is skipped: there
      // are none today, and a new one should be reviewed by hand anyway.
      function idsInJs() {
        const ids = new Map();
        const patterns = [/\$\('([^']+)'\)/g, /getElementById\('([^']+)'\)/g];
        for (const re of patterns) {
          for (const m of js.matchAll(re)) {
            if (m[1].includes('+') || m[1].includes('${')) continue;
            ids.set(m[1], (ids.get(m[1]) || 0) + 1);
          }
        }
        return ids;
      }
      
      // Two elements may not share an id: getElementById returns the first, so code
      // that meant the second one silently reads (or overwrites) the wrong element.
      // A new <select> placed next to an existing hint paragraph did exactly that and
      // only showed up as a picker that would not stay filled.
      test('no id appears twice in the page', () => {
        const counts = new Map();
        for (const id of idsInHtml()) {
          counts.set(id, html.split(`id="${id}"`).length - 1);
        }
        const dupes = [...counts].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).map(([id]) => id);
        assert.deepEqual(dupes, [], `ids defined more than once: ${dupes.join(', ')}`);
      });
      
      test('every id the script looks up exists in the page', () => {
        const inHtml = idsInHtml();
        const missing = [...idsInJs().keys()].filter((id) => !inHtml.has(id));
        assert.deepEqual(missing, [], `app.js reaches for ids the page does not define: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
      });
      
      test('every id in the page is wired to something', () => {
        const used = idsInJs();
        const unused = [...idsInHtml()].filter((id) => !used.has(id));
        // Some ids are only styled or read by CSS; this is a warning list, and the
        // test fails only for ids that look like controls.
        const controls = unused.filter((id) => {
          const re = new RegExp(`<[^>]*\\bid="${id}"[^>]*>`);
          const tag = html.match(re)?.[0] || '';
          return /^<(button|input|textarea|dialog)/.test(tag);
        });
        assert.deepEqual(controls, [], `controls in index.html nothing uses: ${controls.join(', ')}`);
      });
      
      test('the page loads its stylesheet and script from the same folder', () => {
        assert.match(html, /href="app\.css"/);
        assert.match(html, /src="app\.js"/);
      });
      
      // A tab is a button with data-tab and a section with the matching pane id. A
      // mismatch means the tab switches to nothing — visible only by clicking it.
      test('every tab has a pane', () => {
        const tabs = [...html.matchAll(/data-tab="([^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
        assert.ok(tabs.length >= 4, `expected the build/config/device/docs tabs, found ${tabs.join(', ')}`);
        for (const tab of tabs) {
          assert.ok(html.includes(`id="pane-${tab}"`), `tab "${tab}" has no #pane-${tab}`);
        }
        assert.ok(js.includes("'pane-' + name"), 'switchTab no longer builds pane ids the way the test assumes');
      });
      
      // The buttons the server has to serve. Keeping the list here means a handler
      // that is renamed in Go fails this test instead of a 404 in the window.
      test('every api path the script calls exists in server.go', () => {
        const server = readFileSync(join(root, 'gui', 'server.go'), 'utf8');
        // The page uses relative paths ('api/state'); the server registers the whole
        // path under the per-launch token prefix.
        const paths = new Set(
          [...js.matchAll(/api\('([^']+)'/g)]
            .map((m) => m[1].replace(/^api\//, '').split('?')[0])
        );
        const missing = [...paths].filter((p) => !server.includes(`"/api/${p}"`));
        assert.deepEqual(missing, [], `server.go does not register: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
      });
      
- path: stuff/tests/page-harness.js
  content: |
      /* Loads src/webui/index.html's script in a sandbox with a DOM stub.
         The page is one IIFE that wires itself up on load; in Node there is no
         document, so every element is a no-op stand-in and the resource-table
         functions are reached through window.__treble (the page's own test hook).
         The point is to test the shipped code, not a copy of it. */
      "use strict";
      
      const fs = require("fs");
      const path = require("path");
      const vm = require("vm");
      
      const PAGE = path.join(__dirname, "..", "..", "src", "webui", "index.html");
      
      // Any property access returns another stub (except a few that the page reads
      // as values), so getElementById(...).style.setProperty(...) and friends are
      // harmless.
      function fakeEl() {
        const store = {};
        return new Proxy(store, {
          get(target, key) {
            if (key === Symbol.toPrimitive) return () => "";
            if (key in target) return target[key];
            return function () { return fakeEl(); };
          },
          set(target, key, value) { target[key] = value; return true; }
        });
      }
      
      function loadPage(pagePath) {
        const file = pagePath || PAGE;
        const html = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
        const scripts = [...html.matchAll(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)];
        if (!scripts.length) throw new Error("no <script> block in " + file);
        const source = scripts[scripts.length - 1][1];
      
        // The page is run as a function in *this* realm (not a vm context), so the
        // arrays and typed arrays it creates behave like normal Node ones when a
        // test compares them.
        const noopTimer = function () { return 0; };
        const win = { location: { href: "file:///data/adb/modules/test/webroot/index.html" } };
        const factory = new Function(
          "window", "document", "navigator", "setTimeout", "clearTimeout",
          "setInterval", "clearInterval", "console", "atob", "btoa",
          source
        );
        factory.call(win, win, fakeEl(), { userAgent: "node" }, noopTimer, noopTimer,
          noopTimer, noopTimer, console,
          (s) => Buffer.from(String(s), "base64").toString("binary"),
          (s) => Buffer.from(String(s), "binary").toString("base64"));
        if (!win.__treble) throw new Error("the page did not expose its test hook");
        win.__treble.window = win;
        return win;
      }
      
      // A resource value as the framework would read it out of the default config.
      function readResource(page, apkBytes, type, name) {
        const T = page.__treble;
        const entry = T.zipEntry(apkBytes, "resources.arsc");
        const arsc = apkBytes.subarray(entry.offset, entry.offset + entry.size);
        const table = T.readArsc(arsc);
        if (!table) throw new Error("resources.arsc did not parse");
        const pool = T.poolStrings(arsc, table.poolAt);
        const typeId = table.pkg.types.indexOf(type) + 1;
        for (const chunk of table.pkg.chunks) {
          if (chunk.type !== 0x0201 || !chunk.isDefault || chunk.typeId !== typeId) continue;
          for (const e of chunk.entries) {
            if (!e || e.complex) continue;
            if (table.pkg.keys[e.key] !== name) continue;
            return {
              dataType: e.dataType,
              data: e.data,
              string: e.dataType === 0x03 ? pool[e.data] : null,
              // complex dimension: (value << 8) | unit (0 = px, 1 = dip)
              px: e.dataType === 0x05 ? (e.data >>> 8) : null,
              unit: e.dataType === 0x05 ? (e.data & 0xff) : null
            };
          }
        }
        return null;
      }
      
      function arscOf(page, apkBytes) {
        const entry = page.__treble.zipEntry(apkBytes, "resources.arsc");
        return apkBytes.subarray(entry.offset, entry.offset + entry.size);
      }
      
      function readFixture(rel) {
        return new Uint8Array(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "fixtures", rel)));
      }
      
      module.exports = { loadPage, readResource, arscOf, readFixture, fakeEl };

      <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'><rect width='32' height='32' rx='8' fill='%23b93d0e'/><text x='16' y='22' font-size='14' font-weight='700' font-family='sans-serif' fill='%23fff7ef' text-anchor='middle'>TR</text></svg>">
      <link rel="stylesheet" href="app.css">

      <body>

        </div>
      </header>
      
      <nav class="tabs" role="tablist">

        <button class="tab" data-tab="addons" role="tab">Addons</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="files" role="tab">Files</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="device" role="tab">Device</button>

        <button class="tab" data-tab="detect" role="tab">Detect</button>
        <button class="tab" data-tab="docs" role="tab">Docs</button>
      </nav>
      
      <main>
        <!-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- build -->
        <section class="pane is-active" id="pane-build" role="tabpanel">
          <div class="verbs" id="verbs"></div>
      
          <div class="row flags" id="flags-row">
            <span class="row-label">Options</span>
            <div id="flags" class="flag-list"><span class="muted">none for this command</span></div>
          </div>
      
          <div class="row actions">
            <button class="primary" id="run" type="button" disabled>Run</button>
            <button id="stop" type="button" disabled>Stop</button>
            <span class="spacer"></span>
            <button id="open-out" type="button">Open out/</button>
            <span class="muted small" id="run-status"></span>
          </div>
      
          <div class="logwrap">
            <div class="logbar">
              <span id="log-title">Output</span>
              <button class="link" id="log-clear" type="button">clear</button>
            </div>
            <pre id="log" class="log" aria-live="polite"></pre>
          </div>
      
          <!-- The file list is the least interesting thing on the page until a build
               has just finished, so it stays folded at the bottom: the window opens
               on the buttons and the log instead of scrolling a stale out/. -->
          <details class="out-fold" id="out-fold">
            <summary>
              <span class="row-label">Last build</span>
              <button class="link hide-out" id="hide-out" type="button" title="Hide last build output">✕</button>
              <span id="out-summary" class="out-summary">nothing in out/ yet</span>
            </summary>
            <div id="out" class="out-list"><span class="muted">nothing in out/ yet</span></div>
          </details>
        </section>
      
        <!-- --------------------------------------------------------------- config -->
        <section class="pane" id="pane-config" role="tabpanel">
          <div class="row actions">
            <button class="primary" id="cfg-save" type="button" disabled>Save</button>
            <button id="cfg-check" type="button">Check</button>
            <button id="cfg-revert" type="button" disabled>Revert</button>
            <span class="spacer"></span>
            <button class="link" id="cfg-mode" type="button">edit the raw file</button>
            <span class="muted small" id="cfg-status"></span>
          </div>
      
          <!-- Form view: one row per setting, with the file's own comment behind the
               ⓘ. The raw textarea is one click away and is what actually gets
               written, so nothing here can hide a line from the build. -->
          <div id="cfg-fields" class="cfg-fields"></div>
          <textarea id="cfg" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" hidden></textarea>
      
          <p class="hint" id="cfg-hint">
            Saved as <code>config.env</code> in the clone. A line with <code>#</code>
            in front is off — the switch on the left does that for you, keeping the

          </p>
        </section>
      
        <!-- --------------------------------------------------------------- addons -->
        <!-- The other half of the module, separate from config.env: live addons are
             Settings values the module writes at boot (the volume panel side, the

             saved to src/module/addons.conf, which the build packs; the module's own
             page can still change the live ones on the phone without a rebuild. -->
        <section class="pane" id="pane-addons" role="tabpanel">
          <p class="hint addons-intro">
            <b>Module addons.</b> Choices the module owns, not keys in
            <code>config.env</code>. <b>Live</b> addons are Settings values the
            module writes on the phone at every boot — the overlay APK alone does
            not apply them, and the module's page on the phone can change them later.
            <b>Overlay</b> addons are baked into the APK, so from here they take
            effect at the next build and flash — the phone's WebUI can write the same
            entries into the installed APK without a rebuild. Only what is listed in
            <code>src/module/addons.conf</code> is enforced, so an addon you leave

            <h2>Pull what the build needs</h2>
            <p class="hint">
              Both write into <code>stuff/tools/</code> and report in the console above, so
              they can be stopped half way. The vendor tarball is not extracted for
              you: <code>docs/device-extraction.md</code> explains why it has to be
              unpacked one level above <code>src/vendor</code>.
            </p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button data-extract="framework-res" type="button">Pull framework-res.apk</button>
              <button data-extract="vendor" type="button">Pull full vendor (root)</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      
        <!-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- udfps -->
        <!-- The in-display fingerprint question is different from the rest of the
             overlay: the coordinates are not a style choice, they are where the
             sensor physically is. So this pane asks rather than offers defaults, and
             it says which source each answer came from. -->
        <section class="pane" id="pane-udfps" role="tabpanel">
          <div class="card">
            <h2>In-display fingerprint</h2>
            <p class="hint">
              Writes <code>UDFPS_X</code>, <code>UDFPS_Y</code>, <code>UDFPS_RADIUS</code>
              and <code>HAS_UDFPS=true</code>. The sensor's geometry is not a style
              value: a guess puts the lock-screen icon next to the sensor, where no
              finger can reach it.
            </p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="udfps-detect" type="button">Read from the connected phone</button>
              <label class="device-pick">device <select id="udfps-device-pick" class="adb-device-select"></select></label>
            </div>
            <p class="hint" id="udfps-device">
              Works on the OEM ROM and on a GSI. On a GSI the vendor FOD properties
              and the flashed device overlay usually survive, so they are read from
              there instead of the system partition.
            </p>
          </div>
      
          <div class="card">
            <h2>From firmware files</h2>
            <div class="adb-form">
              <input id="udfps-path" type="text" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"
                     placeholder="super.img, a Samsung AP file, or a ROM folder">
              <button id="udfps-pick" type="button" class="pick" title="Choose a super.img, a Samsung AP file, or a partition image">File…</button>
              <button id="udfps-pick-dir" type="button" class="pick" title="Choose the ROM folder or a tree you already unpacked">Folder…</button>
              <button id="udfps-scan" type="button">Scan firmware</button>
            </div>
            <p class="hint">
              Point it at a fastboot ROM's <code>super.img</code>, a Samsung
              <code>AP_*.tar.md5</code>, the ROM folder, or a tree you already
              unpacked. A bare image is unpacked first — <code>super</code>,
              <code>sparse</code>, <code>lz4</code>, <code>erofs</code> and
              <code>ext4</code> are read by the app itself, so nothing has to be
              downloaded or installed for it.
            </p>
          </div>
      
          <div class="card" id="udfps-results" hidden>
            <h2>Answers</h2>
            <p class="muted small" id="udfps-summary"></p>
            <div class="udfps-table-wrap">
              <table class="udfps-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr><th></th><th>Source</th><th>X</th><th>Y</th><th>Radius</th><th>Confidence</th></tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="udfps-rows"></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <p class="hint" id="udfps-detail"></p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="udfps-apply" type="button" disabled>Use the selected values</button>
              <span class="muted small" id="udfps-applied"></span>
            </div>
            <div id="udfps-warnings" class="udfps-notes"></div>
            <div id="udfps-notes" class="udfps-notes"></div>
            <details class="out-fold" id="udfps-files-fold" hidden>
              <summary><span class="row-label">What was read</span></summary>
              <div id="udfps-files" class="udfps-files"></div>
            </details>
            <pre id="udfps-log" class="log" hidden></pre>
          </div>
        </section>
      
        <!-- --------------------------------------------------------------- detect -->
        <!-- The values the overlay copies from the panel: cutout, corner radius,
             status bar height, refresh rates. Unlike a style, each is a fact about
             this phone, and the page shows which source said so — dumpsys, a
             framework resource, an OEM overlay, or an unpacked ROM. -->
        <section class="pane" id="pane-detect" role="tabpanel">
          <div class="card">
            <h2>Automatic detection</h2>
            <p class="hint">
              Reads the display settings the overlay has to match and offers each
              answer with its source. Tick the ones to keep and write them to
              <code>config.env</code>. Nothing is written until you do.
            </p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="detect-run" type="button">Read from the connected phone</button>
              <label class="device-pick">device <select id="detect-device-pick" class="adb-device-select"></select></label>
            </div>
            <p class="hint" id="detect-device">
              Works on the OEM ROM and on a GSI: the panel's corner radius and refresh
              rates come from the display hardware, the cutout and status bar also
              have to be read from the ROM — on a GSI the OEM's own values are gone
              with the OEM system partition.
            </p>
          </div>
      
          <div class="card">
            <h2>From firmware files</h2>
            <div class="adb-form">
              <input id="detect-path" type="text" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"
                     placeholder="super.img, a Samsung AP file, or a ROM folder">
              <button id="detect-pick" type="button" class="pick" title="Choose a super.img, a Samsung AP file, or a partition image">File…</button>
              <button id="detect-pick-dir" type="button" class="pick" title="Choose the ROM folder or a tree you already unpacked">Folder…</button>
              <button id="detect-scan" type="button">Scan firmware</button>
            </div>
            <p class="hint">
              The only source that still has the OEM's cutout path and landscape
              status bar when a GSI has replaced the system partition. Point it at a
              fastboot ROM's <code>super.img</code>, a Samsung
              <code>AP_*.tar.md5</code>, the ROM folder, or a tree you already
              unpacked: a bare image is unpacked first, by the app, with no
              <code>lpunpack</code> or <code>simg2img</code> to install.
            </p>
          </div>
      
          <div class="card" id="detect-results" hidden>
            <h2>Answers</h2>
            <p class="muted small" id="detect-summary"></p>
            <div class="udfps-table-wrap">
              <table class="udfps-table detect-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr><th></th><th>Setting</th><th>Value</th><th>Source</th><th>Confidence</th></tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody id="detect-rows"></tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <p class="hint" id="detect-detail"></p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="detect-apply" type="button" disabled>Write the ticked values</button>
              <span class="muted small" id="detect-applied"></span>
            </div>
            <div id="detect-warnings" class="udfps-notes"></div>
            <div id="detect-notes" class="udfps-notes"></div>
            <details class="out-fold" id="detect-files-fold" hidden>
              <summary><span class="row-label">What was read</span></summary>
              <div id="detect-files" class="udfps-files"></div>
            </details>
            <pre id="detect-log" class="log" hidden></pre>
          </div>
      
          <!-- power_profile.xml is a file, not a value: the tab extracts it and hands
               it back as source XML, so it can be reviewed before it replaces the
               placeholder the build ships. -->
          <div class="card">
            <h2>Power profile</h2>
            <p class="hint">
              Reads <code>res/xml/power_profile.xml</code> from the enabled overlay or
              <code>framework-res.apk</code> and turns the compiled form back into a
              source file. The build compiles it as-is; without it the ROM's own
              profile is used, which on a GSI is the GSI's.
            </p>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="power-read" type="button">Read from the connected phone</button>
              <button id="power-folder" type="button">Read from the folder</button>
            </div>
            <p class="muted small" id="power-summary"></p>
            <pre id="power-preview" class="log" hidden></pre>
            <div class="row actions">
              <button class="primary" id="power-save" type="button" disabled>Save to src/framework/res/xml/power_profile.xml</button>
              <span class="muted small" id="power-saved"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      
        <!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------- docs -->
        <section class="pane" id="pane-docs" role="tabpanel">
          <div class="docs">
            <nav class="docs-nav" id="docs-nav"></nav>
            <article class="docs-body" id="docs-body">
              <p class="muted">Pick a page.</p>
            </article>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>
      
      <dialog id="settings">
        <form method="dialog" id="settings-form">
          <h2>Paths</h2>
      
          <label for="set-clone">Clone folder</label>
          <input id="set-clone" type="text" spellcheck="false" placeholder="C:\Users\you\treble-rro-creator">
          <p class="hint">The folder holding <code>build.sh</code> and <code>stuff/scripts/</code>.</p>
      
          <label for="set-bash">bash</label>
          <input id="set-bash" type="text" spellcheck="false" placeholder="C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe">
          <p class="hint">
            Git Bash on Windows. WSL's <code>bash</code> is rejected: it cannot run the
            native Android tools.
          </p>
      
          <p class="error" id="set-error" hidden></p>
      
          <menu>
            <button value="cancel" formnovalidate>Cancel</button>
            <button value="save" class="primary" id="set-save">Save</button>
          </menu>
        </form>
      </dialog>
      
      <!-- New file / folder. One dialog for both, because the only difference is one
           select: a folder, an empty file, or one of the two templates the app is
           here to help with (a VINTF fragment, a sepolicy starter). -->
      <dialog id="file-new">
        <form method="dialog" id="file-new-form">
          <h2 id="file-new-title">New file</h2>
          <p class="muted small" id="file-new-where"></p>
      
          <label for="file-new-kind">Create</label>
          <select id="file-new-kind">
            <option value="file">an empty file</option>
            <option value="dir">a folder</option>
            <option value="aidl">a VINTF manifest (AIDL template)</option>
            <option value="hidl">a VINTF manifest (HIDL template)</option>
            <option value="sepolicy">SELinux rules (starter template)</option>
          </select>
      
          <label for="file-new-name">Name</label>
          <input id="file-new-name" spellcheck="false" placeholder="android.hardware.biometrics.fingerprint.xml">
          <p class="hint" id="file-new-hint">The HAL name is taken from the file name.</p>
      
          <p class="error" id="file-new-error" hidden></p>
      
          <menu>
            <button type="button" id="file-new-cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" class="primary">Create</button>
          </menu>
        </form>
      </dialog>
      
      <!-- Deleting cannot be undone, so it is the one question the app insists on.
           The destructive button is on the left and Cancel is on the right, styled as
           the primary action and focused when the dialog opens: a stray Enter keeps
           the file. -->
      <dialog id="confirm">
        <form method="dialog">
          <h2 id="confirm-title">Delete?</h2>
          <p class="muted" id="confirm-text"></p>
          <menu>
            <button type="button" class="danger" id="confirm-yes">Delete</button>
            <button type="button" class="primary" id="confirm-no">Cancel</button>
          </menu>
        </form>
      </dialog>
      
      <!-- Update: what is waiting upstream, and what pulling it would do to the files
           that were edited here. The second part is the whole point — a pull that
           overwrites config.env would take the device settings with it. -->
      <!-- Installing packages needs root, and the child has no terminal for sudo to
           ask in. This is the one question the app answers itself: the password is
           handed to sudo -A through stuff/scripts/sudo-askpass.sh for that run only
           and kept in memory for the window's lifetime. -->
      <dialog id="sudo">
        <form method="dialog" id="sudo-form">
          <h2>Install the build tools</h2>
          <p class="muted">
            Installing the missing tools needs root. Enter the password sudo would
            ask for; it stays in this window and is used for the install only.
          </p>
      
          <label for="sudo-password">sudo password</label>
          <input id="sudo-password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" spellcheck="false">
      
          <p class="error" id="sudo-error" hidden></p>
      
          <menu>
            <button type="button" id="sudo-cancel">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" class="primary">Install</button>
          </menu>
        </form>
      </dialog>
      
      <dialog id="update">
        <form method="dialog" id="update-form">
          <h2>Update available</h2>
          <p class="muted" id="upd-head">checking…</p>
      
          <p class="upd-label" id="upd-files-label" hidden>Files the update changes</p>
          <pre class="device-log" id="upd-files" hidden></pre>
      
          <div id="upd-clash" hidden>
            <p class="upd-label">Your uncommitted edits in those files</p>
            <pre class="device-log" id="upd-clash-files"></pre>
            <p class="hint" id="upd-clash-note"></p>
          </div>
      
          <pre class="device-log" id="upd-output" hidden></pre>
          <p class="error" id="upd-error" hidden></p>
      
          <menu>
            <button value="cancel" formnovalidate>Later</button>
            <button type="button" class="primary" id="upd-go">Update now</button>
          </menu>
        </form>
      </dialog>
      
      <script src="app.js"></script>
      </body>
      </html>

      /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
         Same paper palette as src/webui/index.html, so the desktop window and the

      :root {

      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      
      /* Tell the browser which way the controls should look: without this the scroll
         bars and the select popups stay light on the dark theme, which is the one
         piece of native chrome that does not follow the palette below. */
      :root { color-scheme: light; }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { color-scheme: dark; } }
      
      /* One scrollbar for the whole window, the same on every pane that scrolls
         (config form, log, files): a thin trackless bar in the rule colour. */
      * { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--rule-strong) transparent; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: var(--rule-strong);

      html, body {
        height: 100%;
