        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .chip.plain:hover { border-color: var(--rule); color: var(--muted); background: none; }
      .chip.plain:active { transform: none; }
      .chip .dot {
        width: 7px;
        height: 7px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--rule-strong);
        flex: none;
      }
      .chip[data-tone="ok"] .dot { background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35, 98, 74, .14); }
      .chip[data-tone="warn"] .dot { background: var(--warn); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138, 90, 0, .14); }
      .chip[data-tone="bad"] .dot { background: var(--bad); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(163, 37, 27, .14); }
      
      /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- tabs -- */
      .tabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 0 14px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel);
      }
      .tab {
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        border-radius: 0;
        padding: 9px 12px 8px;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 13px;
        border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
        margin-bottom: -1px;
        transition: color .12s var(--ease), border-color .12s var(--ease);
      }
      .tab:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; color: var(--ink); }
      .tab.is-active { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
      
      main { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; }
      .pane { display: none; flex: 1; min-height: 0; flex-direction: column; padding: 16px 20px 18px; overflow: auto; }
      .pane.is-active { display: flex; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------- verbs -- */
      .verbs {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
        gap: 8px;
      }
      .verb {
        text-align: left;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        transition: border-color .12s var(--ease), background .12s var(--ease), color .12s var(--ease);
      }
      .verb h3 { font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
      .verb p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.35; }
      .verb.is-active { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .verb.is-active h3 { color: var(--accent); }
      
      .row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .row-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .08em;
        color: var(--muted);
        min-width: 74px;
      }
      .flag-list { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      label.flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; }
      label.flag input { accent-color: var(--accent); }
      .flag-name { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; }
      .actions .spacer { flex: 1; }
      .muted { color: var(--muted); }
      .small { font-size: 12px; }
      
      /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- log -- */
      .logwrap {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 180px;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        margin-top: 14px;
        border: 1px solid var(--console-rule);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        overflow: hidden;
        background: var(--console);
      }
      .logbar {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 6px 12px;
        background: #22241a;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--console-rule);
        color: #8f9179;
        font-size: 11.5px;
        letter-spacing: .04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }
      .logbar .link { color: #8f9179; }
      .log {
        flex: 1;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        overflow: auto;
        color: var(--console-ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.25px;
        line-height: 1.45;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-break: break-word;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      .log .err { color: #f0a08f; }
      .log .note { color: #8f9179; font-style: italic; }
      .log .done-ok { color: #8fd6a8; font-weight: 600; }
      .log .done-bad { color: #f0a08f; font-weight: 600; }
      
      /* --------------------------------------------------------------------- out -- */
      .out-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-size: 12.5px; }
      .out-item { display: flex; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--mono); }
      .out-item span:first-child { color: var(--ink); }
      .out-item span:last-child { color: var(--muted); }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ config -- */
      textarea#cfg {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 240px;
        margin-top: 14px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--console);
        color: var(--console-ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
        line-height: 1.55;
        resize: none;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      .hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }
      .hint code { background: var(--panel-2); padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 4px; }
      
      /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- docs -- */
      .docs { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; gap: 18px; }
      .docs-nav {
        width: 190px;
        flex: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 2px;
        overflow: auto;
      }
      .docs-nav button {
        text-align: left;
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 6px 9px;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        color: var(--muted);
        transition: background .12s var(--ease), color .12s var(--ease);
      }
      .docs-nav button:hover { background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); }
      .docs-nav button.is-active { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
      .docs-body {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: auto;
        padding: 2px 18px 40px 4px;
        font-size: 13.5px;
        line-height: 1.62;
      }
      .docs-body h1 { font-size: 19px; margin: 4px 0 12px; }
      .docs-body h2 { font-size: 15.5px; margin: 22px 0 8px; padding-top: 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
      .docs-body h3 { font-size: 13.5px; margin: 16px 0 6px; }
      .docs-body p { margin: 8px 0; }
      .docs-body ul, .docs-body ol { margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 22px; }
      .docs-body li { margin: 3px 0; }
      .docs-body pre {
        background: var(--console);
        color: var(--console-ink);
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        overflow: auto;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .docs-body :not(pre) > code {
        background: var(--panel-2);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        padding: 0 4px;
        border-radius: 4px;
      }
      .docs-body blockquote {
        margin: 10px 0;
        padding: 2px 0 2px 12px;
        border-left: 3px solid var(--rule-strong);
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .docs-body table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 12.5px; }
      .docs-body th, .docs-body td { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; }
      .docs-body th { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .docs-body .md-link { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; }
      .docs-body .md-ext { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: underline dotted; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font: inherit; }
      .docs-body hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); margin: 18px 0; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ device -- */
      .card {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 14px 16px;
        margin-bottom: 14px;
      }
      .card h2 { font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      /* Same box as the Build console (border, bar, dark pane), but with a height of
         its own: this pane scrolls through cards, so flex: 1 has nothing to fill. */
      .device-logwrap {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        min-height: 0;
        height: clamp(200px, 36vh, 320px);
        margin-top: 10px;
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------- last build -- */
      /* Folded away: the window should open on the buttons and the log, not on a
         list of what an earlier build produced. It opens itself when a build has
         just finished, and is one click away otherwise. */
      .out-fold {
        margin-top: 12px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
        padding-top: 8px;
      }
      .out-fold > summary {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 10px;
        cursor: pointer;
        list-style: none;
        padding: 3px 0;
      }
      .out-fold > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
      .out-fold > summary::before {
        content: "▸";
        color: var(--rule-strong);
        font-size: 10px;
        transition: transform .12s var(--ease);
      }
      .out-fold[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
      .out-summary { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink); }
      .out-fold .out-list { margin: 8px 0 2px 22px; }
      
      /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- config -- */
      /* One row per setting. The switch is the `#`, the value box is the right-hand
         side of the `=`, and the ⓘ is the comment block the file already had. */
      .cfg-fields { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; margin-top: 12px; padding-right: 4px; }
      .cfg-sec { margin-bottom: 18px; }
      .cfg-sec-title {
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .08em;
        color: var(--muted);
        padding-bottom: 5px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
        margin-bottom: 8px;
      }
      .cfg-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: auto auto minmax(150px, max-content) minmax(0, 1fr);
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 3px 0;
      }
      .cfg-row.is-off .cfg-key,
      .cfg-row.is-off .cfg-value { color: var(--muted); }
      .cfg-row.is-dirty .cfg-key { color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-on {
        appearance: none;
        -webkit-appearance: none;
        width: 30px;
        height: 17px;
        margin: 0;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--track-base);
        position: relative;
        cursor: pointer;
        flex: none;
        transition: background .12s var(--ease), border-color .12s;
      }
      .cfg-on::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: 1px;
        left: 1px;
        width: 13px;
        height: 13px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #fff;
        box-shadow: var(--tick);
        transition: transform .12s var(--ease);
      }
      .cfg-on:checked { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-on:checked::after { transform: translateX(13px); }
      .cfg-key {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .cfg-value {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 5px 8px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .cfg-value:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: none; }
      .cfg-row.is-off .cfg-value { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .cfg-info {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
        padding: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: none;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 11px;
        font-style: italic;
        font-family: Georgia, serif;
        line-height: 1;
        flex: none;
      }
      .cfg-info:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-info[aria-expanded="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-info:disabled { opacity: .3; }
      .cfg-info-text {
        grid-column: 2 / -1;
        margin-left: 28px;
        margin: 2px 0 8px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-left: 2px solid var(--rule-strong);
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
      }
      
      /* ---- addons -------------------------------------------------------------- */
      /* The overlay cannot do these, so the pane says what does: each row is a
         Settings value the module writes on the phone, with the value it would
         write. The control is small because the sentence is the point. */
      .addons-intro { max-width: 76ch; margin: 0 0 14px; }
      .addons {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        overflow: hidden;
        /* The pane is a flex column and the list is a flex item: with overflow
           hidden its automatic minimum height is 0, so in a short window it shrank
           and clipped the last rows instead of letting the pane scroll. */
        flex: none;
      }
      .addon-row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 18px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      }
      .addon-row:first-child { border-top: 0; }
      .addon-row.is-dirty { background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .addon-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
      .addon-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
      .addon-key { margin-left: 8px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
      .addon-tag {
        margin-left: 8px;
        padding: 1px 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 999px;
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: .06em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--muted);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .addon-summary { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }
      .addon-side { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex: none; }
      .addon-side select { max-width: 140px; min-width: 96px; font-family: var(--sans); }
      .addon-switch { display: inline-flex; }
      .addon-default {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: var(--muted);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .addon-default[hidden] { display: none; }
      .addon-state { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
      .addon-state[data-diff="true"] { color: var(--accent); }
      
      /* ---- match property ------------------------------------------------------- */
      /* The card sits inside the Overlay activation section, between the rows and the
         next heading. A wrong match condition is invisible in the built module, so it
         gets more room than a normal setting. */
      .cfg-match {
        margin: 10px 0 4px;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--panel-2);
      }
      .cfg-match-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .cfg-match-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; }
      .cfg-match-head select { margin-left: auto; max-width: 320px; min-width: 200px; }
      .cfg-match .hint { margin: 6px 0 8px; }
      .cfg-match-summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .cfg-match-summary .muted { white-space: nowrap; }
      .cfg-match-row {
        padding: 7px 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      }
      .cfg-match-row-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .cfg-match-prop { font-size: 12px; }
      .cfg-match-eq { color: var(--muted); }
      .cfg-match-val { font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-match-row-head button { margin-left: auto; }
      .cfg-match-badge {
        font-size: 10px;
        letter-spacing: .04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        padding: 1px 6px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .cfg-match-badge.trust-high { border-color: var(--ok); color: var(--ok); }
      .cfg-match-badge.trust-medium { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
      .cfg-match-badge.trust-low { opacity: .8; }
      .cfg-match-why { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.45; }
      .cfg-match-risk { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--warn); line-height: 1.45; }
      .cfg-match-rejected { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
      .cfg-match-error { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--bad); }
      .cfg-match-warn {
        margin: 0 0 8px;
        padding: 7px 9px;
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.45;
        border-left: 2px solid var(--warn);
        color: var(--warn);
      }
      .cfg-match details { margin-top: 6px; }
      .cfg-match summary { cursor: pointer; }
      @keyframes cfg-flash {
        from { background: var(--accent-soft); }
        to { background: transparent; }
      }
      .cfg-row.is-flash { animation: cfg-flash 1.4s var(--ease); border-radius: 4px; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ device -- */
      .adb-form { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
      .adb-form input {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--panel-2);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
      }
      .adb-values { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; }
      .adb-values label {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 4px;
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .07em;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .adb-values input {
        padding: 6px 9px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--panel-2);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        width: 150px;
      }
      /* The device picker: the same field as the inputs above, wide enough for a
         serial, repeated on the tabs that probe a phone. */
      .adb-values select,
      .device-pick select,
      .cfg-match-head select,
      .addon-side select {
        padding: 6px 9px;
        border-radius: 7px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--panel-2);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-size: 12px;
        max-width: 320px;
      }
      .adb-values select { font-family: var(--mono); }
      .device-row { margin: 10px 0 4px; }
      .device-row > button { align-self: flex-end; }
      .device-pick {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        margin-left: 10px;
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .07em;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      
      /* The answer Detect gave, with its caret over the codename box it filled. */
      .detect-note {
        position: relative;
        margin: 12px 0 0;
        max-width: 440px;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--panel-2);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }
      .detect-note::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: -6px;
        left: 18px;
        width: 10px;
        height: 10px;
        background: var(--panel-2);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-top: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        transform: rotate(45deg);
      }
      .detect-note p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
      .detect-note code { color: var(--ink); }
      /* Drawn as a button, not as a link: it is the way out of a wrong answer, and
         the thing it sits next to (the codename) is a field, not prose. */
      .detect-note .link {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-top: 6px;
        padding: 3px 9px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background: var(--panel);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-size: 11.5px;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .detect-note .link:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
      .presets { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .preset-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
      .preset-group h3 {
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .08em;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin: 2px 0 1px;
      }
      .preset {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(170px, 260px) minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 10px;
        align-items: baseline;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 6px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel-2);
      }
      .preset:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .preset code { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--ink); }
      .preset .why { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }
      .preset .advice { color: var(--warn); font-size: 11px; margin-top: 2px; display: block; }
      
      /* Output of a preset, directly under the command that produced it: the answer
         is read where the question was clicked, not at the top of the pane. The rule
         on the left ties the panel to the button above it. */
      .preset-out {
        margin: -3px 0 6px 10px;
        padding: 2px 0 0 10px;
        border-left: 2px solid var(--rule-strong);
        animation: preset-out-in .16s var(--ease);
      }
      .preset-out-bar {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 0 0 6px;
      }
      /* Real buttons, not links: Copy is the one worth reaching for, so it wears the
         accent. The base button rule already supplies border, radius and hover. */
      .preset-out-bar button { padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 11.5px; }
      .preset-log {
        margin: 0;
        max-height: 220px;
        overflow: auto;
        padding: 0;
        background: none;
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
        font-weight: 650;
        line-height: 1.5;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-break: break-word;
      }
      @keyframes preset-out-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      
      .adb-form kbd,
      .hint kbd {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 11px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-bottom-width: 2px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        padding: 0 4px;
        background: var(--panel-2);
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------- files -- */
      /* Two panes, like the Docs tab: the tree is the clone's src/ (what the build
         reads), the right side is whatever file is open. Disabled files stay in place
         in the tree, greyed, because their location is the thing worth knowing. */
      .files { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; gap: 16px; }
      .files-side { width: 330px; flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-height: 0; }
      .files-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
      .files-tools button { padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
      .files-target {
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 11.5px;
        color: var(--muted);
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .files-target code { color: var(--ink); }
      .files-quick { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
      .files-quick button { flex: 1; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 11.5px; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--muted); }
      .files-quick button:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .files-tree {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 160px;
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 4px 0;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .files-tree.is-drop { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .files-tree:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
      .ft-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px 2px 6px; transition: background .12s var(--ease), box-shadow .12s var(--ease); }
      .ft-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .ft-row.is-target { background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
      .ft-row.is-selected { background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .ft-row.is-selected .ft-label { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
      .ft-row.is-off .ft-label { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
      .ft-main {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 1px 0;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 5px;
        text-align: left;
        font: inherit;
        color: inherit;
      }
      .ft-main:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; }
      .ft-caret { width: 9px; flex: none; color: var(--rule-strong); font-size: 9px; }
      button.ft-caret {
        width: 14px;
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        color: var(--rule-strong);
        font-size: 9px;
        line-height: 1;
        flex: none;
      }
      button.ft-caret:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; color: var(--accent); }
      .ft-icon { width: 11px; flex: none; color: var(--faint); font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
      .ft-label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ft-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--faint); flex: none; }
      .ft-off {
        padding: 0 5px;
        font-size: 10px;
        line-height: 15px;
        border-radius: 4px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: none;
        color: var(--muted);
      }
      .ft-off:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .ft-badge {
        flex: none;
        font-family: var(--sans);
        font-size: 8.5px;
        line-height: 13px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .06em;
        color: var(--muted);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 999px;
        padding: 0 5px;
      }
      .ft-empty { padding: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 12px; }
      
      .files-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
      .files-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .files-head .spacer { flex: 1; }
      .file-path {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        background: var(--panel-2);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: 6px;
        padding: 3px 7px;
        max-width: 56ch;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      #file-editor {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 240px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--console);
        color: var(--console-ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
        line-height: 1.55;
        resize: none;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      #file-editor[hidden], .file-placeholder[hidden], .file-checks[hidden] { display: none; }
      .file-placeholder {
        flex: 1;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border: 1px dashed var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        padding: 30px 18px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 12.5px;
      }
      .file-checks {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 8px 11px;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .file-checks.is-bad { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); }
      .check-head { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .check-warn { color: var(--warn); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; }
      .check-bad { color: var(--bad); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; }
      .check-hals { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 5px; line-height: 1.5; }
      .check-hals code { color: var(--ink); }
      
      /* A selected folder fills the right pane with what it holds, so the answer to
         "what will this upload overwrite?" is visible before the picker opens. */
      .folder-view { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
      .folder-view[hidden] { display: none; }
      .folder-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
      .folder-line { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; }
      .folder-line code { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink); }
      .folder-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
      .folder-actions button { padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 11.5px; }
      .folder-actions button:disabled { opacity: .45; }
      .folder-list {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 4px 0;
      }
      .fo-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 1px 8px 1px 10px; }
      .fo-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .fo-main {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 4px 0;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        text-align: left;
      }
      .fo-main:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; color: var(--accent); }
      .fo-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      .fo-meta { flex: none; margin-left: auto; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--faint); }
      .fo-row.is-off .fo-name { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
      .fo-empty { padding: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ update -- */
      .upd-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .08em;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin: 12px 0 5px;
      }
      /* The same dark pane as the build console. `overflow: auto` is what the 150px
         cap needs: a `<pre>` clips nothing by default, so a long file list kept
         painting past its box and landed on top of the pull output and the buttons
         below it. */
      .device-log {
        margin: 0;
        max-height: 150px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--console-rule);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--console);
        color: var(--console-ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.45;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-break: break-word;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ dialog -- */
      dialog {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: var(--paper);
        color: var(--ink);
        padding: 20px 22px 16px;
        width: min(560px, 92vw);
        /* A dialog taller than the window is centred, so its heading ends up off the
           top edge with no way to scroll back to it. Cap it and let it scroll. */
        max-height: calc(100vh - 48px);
        overflow: auto;
        box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -40px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
      }
      dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(23, 24, 15, .45); }
      dialog h2 { font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
      dialog label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
      dialog input, dialog select {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--panel);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
      }
      dialog menu {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 8px;
        margin: 16px 0 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
      /* The delete confirmation puts the destructive action on the left, away from
         where the pointer and Enter land; Cancel is the primary-styled one and sits
         at the far right. */
      #confirm menu { justify-content: space-between; }
      button.danger { color: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); }
      button.danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); }
      .error { color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 12.5px; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------- udfps -- */
      /* A table rather than cards: the interesting thing is how the answers from
         different sources compare, which only reads when they share columns. */
      .udfps-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin: 10px 0 2px; }
      .udfps-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
      .udfps-table th {
        text-align: left;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .07em;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-weight: 600;
        padding: 0 8px 6px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      }
      .udfps-table td { padding: 7px 8px 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); vertical-align: top; transition: background .12s var(--ease); }
      .udfps-table tr { cursor: pointer; }
      .udfps-table tr:hover td { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .udfps-table tr.is-picked td { background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .udfps-table td.num, .udfps-table td.udfps-source { font-family: var(--mono); }
      .udfps-table td.num { white-space: nowrap; }
      .udfps-table input { margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
      .udfps-conf { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .udfps-conf.high { color: var(--ok); }
      .udfps-conf.medium { color: var(--warn); }
      .udfps-conf.guess, .udfps-conf.low { color: var(--bad); }
      .udfps-notes p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12px; }
      .udfps-notes p.warn { color: var(--warn); }
      .udfps-files { padding: 4px 0 2px; }
      .udfps-file { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
      .udfps-file code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; word-break: break-all; }
      #udfps-log { margin-top: 10px; max-height: 220px; }
      
      @media (max-width: 760px) {
        .docs { flex-direction: column; }
        .docs-nav { width: auto; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: visible; }
        .files { flex-direction: column; }
        .files-side { width: auto; }
        .files-tree { min-height: 120px; max-height: 32vh; }
        .chips { display: none; }
        #sub { max-width: 70vw; }
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ motion -- */
      /* Short, one-shot, and made of opacity plus a couple of pixels: enough to show
         that something changed, never enough to watch. Nothing loops and nothing
         bounces — the tabs, dialogs and answer cards are used dozens of times a
         session, and a flourish is a tax on every one of them. */
      @keyframes pane-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(2px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      .pane.is-active { animation: pane-in .13s var(--ease); }
      
      @keyframes dialog-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px) scale(.995); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      dialog[open] { animation: dialog-in .15s var(--ease); }
      @keyframes backdrop-in { from { opacity: 0; } }
      dialog[open]::backdrop { animation: backdrop-in .15s ease-out; }
      
      /* The answer cards are unhidden when a scan starts, so the fade is the
         acknowledgement that the click landed. The power profile is the same. */
      @keyframes card-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      #udfps-results:not([hidden]),
      #detect-results:not([hidden]),
      #power-preview:not([hidden]) { animation: card-in .15s var(--ease); }
      
      /* A folder dragged over the tree: the border is the target, and it should not
         snap between states while the pointer crosses it. */
      .files-tree { transition: border-color .12s var(--ease), background .12s var(--ease); }
      
      /* The one-line status next to Run appears and clears on its own; an instant
         swap draws the eye to the corner it is in. */
      #run-status { transition: opacity .15s var(--ease); }
      #run-status:empty { opacity: 0; }
      
      /* One switch for the people the animations cost something: the app has no
         animation that carries information, so none of them has to survive this. */
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *, *::before, *::after {
          animation-duration: .001ms !important;
          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
          transition-duration: .001ms !important;
        }
      }

      'use strict';
      
      /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
         The window is a thin client over the handlers in server.go. Everything it
         can do is one of build.sh's verbs, so there is no build logic here: it picks
         a verb, ticks flags, and renders what the child prints.
      
         Three panes talk to the phone or edit files — config.env, adb and the src/
         workspace — and all of them go through the server, which owns the parsing,
         the path rules and every write. Nothing here touches the disk directly.
         --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
      
      const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
      
      function el(tag, cls, text) {
        const node = document.createElement(tag);
        if (cls) node.className = cls;
        if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
        return node;
      }
      
      const FLAG_HELP = {
        '--with-vendor-hals': 'include src/vendor/ in the module',

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------- log --
      function connectLog() {
        const stream = new EventSource('api/log');
      
        stream.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          let line;
          try { line = JSON.parse(event.data); } catch (_) { return; }
          // seq restarts at 1 on every run, and the server replays its buffer to a
          // reconnecting client: either way a slow seq means "new run, start over".
          if (line.seq <= lastSeq) {
            clearLog();
            lastSeq = 0;
          }
          lastSeq = line.seq;

          // action to take. The sentence before it already explained why.

            openSudoPrompt();
            return;

      function renderLogLine(pre, line) {
        const stick = pre.scrollTop + pre.clientHeight >= pre.scrollHeight - 30;
      
        if (line.stream === 'progress') {
          // pacman and adb pull repaint one line with \r. Rewrite that line instead
          // of appending a row per chunk, so a download reads like a terminal.
          let live = progressNode.get(pre);
          if (!live || live.parentNode !== pre) {
            live = document.createElement('span');
            live.className = 'progress';
            pre.appendChild(live);
            progressNode.set(pre, live);
          }
          live.textContent = line.text + '\n';
          if (stick) pre.scrollTop = pre.scrollHeight;
          return false;
        }
        // Any real line ends the bar's run: the next repaint starts a new line.
        progressNode.delete(pre);
      
        const node = document.createElement('span');
      
        if (line.stream === 'done') {
          node.className = /finished/.test(line.text) ? 'done-ok' : 'done-bad';
          node.textContent = '— ' + line.text + ' —\n';
          pre.appendChild(node);
          if (stick) pre.scrollTop = pre.scrollHeight;
          return true;
        }
        if (line.stream === 'note') {
          node.className = 'note';
          node.textContent = '· ' + line.text + '\n';
        } else if (line.stream === 'err') {
          node.className = 'err';
          node.innerHTML = ansiToHtml(line.text) + '\n';
        } else {
          node.innerHTML = ansiToHtml(line.text) + '\n';
        }
        pre.appendChild(node);
        if (stick) pre.scrollTop = pre.scrollHeight;
        return false;
      }

          const rows = box.querySelectorAll('.cfg-row');

      async function probeDetect(mode) {
        const buttons = [$('detect-run'), $('detect-scan')];
        for (const b of buttons) b.disabled = true;
        const pick = adbDeviceChoice();
        if (mode !== 'firmware' && pick.blocked) {
          for (const b of buttons) b.disabled = false;
          $('detect-summary').textContent = pick.blocked;
          return;
        }
        $('detect-results').hidden = false;
        $('detect-rows').textContent = '';
        $('detect-warnings').textContent = '';
        $('detect-notes').textContent = '';
        $('detect-detail').textContent = '';
        $('detect-applied').textContent = '';
        $('detect-files-fold').hidden = true;
        $('detect-log').hidden = true;
        $('detect-apply').disabled = true;
        detectReport = null;
        detectPick = {};
        detectFirmware = null;
        $('detect-summary').textContent = mode === 'firmware' ? 'reading the firmware…' : 'asking the phone…';
      
        try {
          const res = await api('api/detect', {
            method: 'POST',
            body: {
              action: 'probe',
              mode,
              serial: pick.serial,
              path: mode === 'firmware' ? $('detect-path').value.trim() : '',

          detectReport = res.report;
          detectFirmware = res.firmware || null;
          renderDetect(res.log);

      /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
         Same paper palette as src/webui/index.html, so the desktop window and the
         on-device WebUI read as one product. Light by default, dark when the system
         asks for it.
         --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
      :root {
        --paper: #f2eee3;
        --panel: #f7f3e8;
        --panel-2: #efeade;
        --ink: #17180f;
        --muted: #5f5f51;
        --rule: #cfc8b7;
        --rule-strong: #a9a18d;
        --accent: #b93d0e;
        --accent-press: #9d3109;
        --on-accent: #fff7ef;
        --accent-soft: rgba(185, 61, 14, .10);
        --ok: #23624a;
        --warn: #8a5a00;
        --bad: #a3251b;
        --bad-soft: rgba(163, 37, 27, .07);
        --console: #1a1b13;
        --console-ink: #d6d3bf;
        --console-rule: #34362a;
        /* The same extra tokens the WebUI uses, so a switch or a track looks the
           same on the phone and in this window. */
        --faint: #66655a;
        --track-base: #e3ddcd;
        --tick: rgba(23, 24, 15, .18);
        --panel-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .55) inset;
        --sans: "Roboto", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
        --mono: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", "Roboto Mono", "Droid Sans Mono", monospace;
        --ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, 0, 1);
        --shadow: 0 20px 44px -32px rgba(23, 24, 15, .55);
        --radius: 10px;
      }
      
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
        :root {
          --paper: #121310;
          --panel: #191b16;
          --panel-2: #1f211a;
          --ink: #e8e5d5;
          --muted: #a2a08f;
          --rule: #2f3229;
          --rule-strong: #474b3d;
          --accent: #e2683a;
          --accent-press: #c9532a;
          --on-accent: #1a1209;
          --accent-soft: rgba(226, 104, 58, .14);
          --ok: #6fbf95;
          --warn: #d4a044;
          --bad: #e08377;
          --bad-soft: rgba(224, 131, 119, .12);
          --console: #0b0c09;
          --console-ink: #cfccb8;
          --console-rule: #262a20;
          --faint: #7f7d6e;
          --track-base: #33362c;
          --tick: rgba(0, 0, 0, .35);
          --panel-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .04) inset;
        }
      }
      
      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      
      /* Tell the browser which way the controls should look: without this the scroll
         bars and the select popups stay light on the dark theme, which is the one
         piece of native chrome that does not follow the palette below. */
      :root { color-scheme: light; }
      @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { color-scheme: dark; } }
      
      /* One scrollbar for the whole window, the same on every pane that scrolls
         (config form, log, files): a thin trackless bar in the rule colour. */
      * { scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--rule-strong) transparent; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 2px solid transparent;
        background-clip: content-box;
      }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--muted); background-clip: content-box; }
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-corner { background: transparent; }
      
      html, body {
        height: 100%;
        margin: 0;
      }
      
      body {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        background: var(--paper);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--sans);
        font-size: 14px;
        line-height: 1.5;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
      
      h1, h2, h3 { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
      p { margin: 0; }
      code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: .92em; }
      ::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
      
      button {
        font: inherit;
        color: inherit;
        background: var(--panel);
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 7px 13px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background .12s var(--ease, ease), border-color .12s, transform .06s;
      }
      button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--panel-2); }
      button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
      button:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }
      button.primary {
        background: var(--accent);
        border-color: var(--accent);
        color: var(--on-accent);
        font-weight: 600;
      }
      button.primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--accent-press); border-color: var(--accent-press); }
      button.link {
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        padding: 0;
        color: var(--muted);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: 2px;
      }
      button.link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: none; }
      :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
      
      /* ----------------------------------------------------------------- filters -- */
      /* The in-place search boxes (config.env, Docs, Device). They sit inside the
         list they narrow, so they take the same paper panel and rule as the other
         inputs — left to the browser they would be a white box on cream paper. */
      .filter-input {
        width: 100%;
        margin: 0 0 10px;
        padding: 7px 10px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--panel-2);
        color: var(--ink);
        font: inherit;
        font-size: 12.5px;
        transition: border-color .12s, background .12s, box-shadow .12s;
      }
      .filter-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint); }
      .filter-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--accent);
        background: var(--panel);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
      }
      /* The list scrolls under the filter instead of carrying it away. */
      .cfg-fields > .filter-input,
      .docs-nav > .filter-input {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 2;
      }
      .docs-nav > .filter-input { padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12px; }
      .filter-empty {
        margin: 2px 0 0;
        padding: 0 9px;
        color: var(--faint);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ header -- */
      .top {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 18px;
        padding: 14px 20px 12px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel);
      }
      .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-width: 0; }
      .mark {
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 32px;
        height: 32px;
        border-radius: 9px;
        background: var(--accent);
        color: var(--on-accent);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 13px;
        letter-spacing: .02em;
        flex: none;
      }
      .brand-text { min-width: 0; }
      
      [read_files: showing lines 1-200 of 1230. Use code_search to locate the part you need and read a window around it, or call read_files again with offset=201 to continue.]
      
        line-height: 1.55;
        resize: none;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      #file-editor[hidden], .file-placeholder[hidden], .file-checks[hidden] { display: none; }
      .file-placeholder {
        flex: 1;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        border: 1px dashed var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        padding: 30px 18px;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 12.5px;
      }
      .file-checks {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 8px 11px;
        font-size: 12px;
      }
      .file-checks.is-bad { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); }
      .check-head { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .check-warn { color: var(--warn); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; }
      .check-bad { color: var(--bad); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; }
      .check-hals { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 5px; line-height: 1.5; }
      .check-hals code { color: var(--ink); }
      
      /* A selected folder fills the right pane with what it holds, so the answer to
         "what will this upload overwrite?" is visible before the picker opens. */
      .folder-view { flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
      .folder-view[hidden] { display: none; }
      .folder-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
      .folder-line { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0; }
      .folder-line code { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink); }
      .folder-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
      .folder-actions button { padding: 5px 9px; font-size: 11.5px; }
      .folder-actions button:disabled { opacity: .45; }
      .folder-list {
        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule);
        border-radius: var(--radius);
        background: var(--panel);
        padding: 4px 0;
      }
      .fo-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 1px 8px 1px 10px; }
      .fo-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .fo-main {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 4px 0;
        background: none;
        border: 0;
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        color: var(--ink);
        text-align: left;
      }
      .fo-main:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; color: var(--accent); }
      .fo-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      .fo-meta { flex: none; margin-left: auto; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--faint); }
      .fo-row.is-off .fo-name { color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; }
      .fo-empty { padding: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ update -- */
      .upd-label {
        font-size: 11px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .08em;
        color: var(--muted);
        margin: 12px 0 5px;
      }
      /* The same dark pane as the build console. `overflow: auto` is what the 150px
         cap needs: a `<pre>` clips nothing by default, so a long file list kept
         painting past its box and landed on top of the pull output and the buttons
         below it. */
      .device-log {
        margin: 0;
        max-height: 150px;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        overflow: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--console-rule);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: var(--console);
        color: var(--console-ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.45;
        white-space: pre-wrap;
        word-break: break-word;
        tab-size: 4;
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ dialog -- */
      dialog {
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: var(--paper);
        color: var(--ink);
        padding: 20px 22px 16px;
        width: min(560px, 92vw);
        /* A dialog taller than the window is centred, so its heading ends up off the
           top edge with no way to scroll back to it. Cap it and let it scroll. */
        max-height: calc(100vh - 48px);
        overflow: auto;
        box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -40px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
      }
      dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(23, 24, 15, .45); }
      dialog h2 { font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
      dialog label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
      dialog input, dialog select {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 8px 10px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: var(--panel);
        color: var(--ink);
        font-family: var(--mono);
        font-size: 12.5px;
      }
      dialog menu {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        gap: 8px;
        margin: 16px 0 0;
        padding: 0;
      }
      /* The delete confirmation puts the destructive action on the left, away from
         where the pointer and Enter land; Cancel is the primary-styled one and sits
         at the far right. */
      #confirm menu { justify-content: space-between; }
      button.danger { color: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); }
      button.danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); }
      .error { color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-soft); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 12.5px; }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------- udfps -- */
      /* A table rather than cards: the interesting thing is how the answers from
         different sources compare, which only reads when they share columns. */
      .udfps-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin: 10px 0 2px; }
      .udfps-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
      .udfps-table th {
        text-align: left;
        font-size: 10.5px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: .07em;
        color: var(--muted);
        font-weight: 600;
        padding: 0 8px 6px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      }
      .udfps-table td { padding: 7px 8px 7px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); vertical-align: top; transition: background .12s var(--ease); }
      .udfps-table tr { cursor: pointer; }
      .udfps-table tr:hover td { background: var(--panel-2); }
      .udfps-table tr.is-picked td { background: var(--accent-soft); }
      .udfps-table td.num, .udfps-table td.udfps-source { font-family: var(--mono); }
      .udfps-table td.num { white-space: nowrap; }
      .udfps-table input { margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: var(--accent); }
      .udfps-conf { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .udfps-conf.high { color: var(--ok); }
      .udfps-conf.medium { color: var(--warn); }
      .udfps-conf.guess, .udfps-conf.low { color: var(--bad); }
      .udfps-notes p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 12px; }
      .udfps-notes p.warn { color: var(--warn); }
      .udfps-files { padding: 4px 0 2px; }
      .udfps-file { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
      .udfps-file code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; word-break: break-all; }
      #udfps-log { margin-top: 10px; max-height: 220px; }
      
      @media (max-width: 760px) {
        .docs { flex-direction: column; }
        .docs-nav { width: auto; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: visible; }
        .files { flex-direction: column; }
        .files-side { width: auto; }
        .files-tree { min-height: 120px; max-height: 32vh; }
        .chips { display: none; }
        #sub { max-width: 70vw; }
      }
      
      /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ motion -- */
      /* Short, one-shot, and made of opacity plus a couple of pixels: enough to show
         that something changed, never enough to watch. Nothing loops and nothing
         bounces — the tabs, dialogs and answer cards are used dozens of times a
         session, and a flourish is a tax on every one of them. */
      @keyframes pane-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(2px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      .pane.is-active { animation: pane-in .13s var(--ease); }
      
      @keyframes dialog-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px) scale(.995); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      dialog[open] { animation: dialog-in .15s var(--ease); }
      @keyframes backdrop-in { from { opacity: 0; } }
      dialog[open]::backdrop { animation: backdrop-in .15s ease-out; }
      
      /* The answer cards are unhidden when a scan starts, so the fade is the
         acknowledgement that the click landed. The power profile is the same. */
      @keyframes card-in {
        from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); }
        to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      }
      #udfps-results:not([hidden]),
      #detect-results:not([hidden]),
      #power-preview:not([hidden]) { animation: card-in .15s var(--ease); }
      
      /* A folder dragged over the tree: the border is the target, and it should not
         snap between states while the pointer crosses it. */
      .files-tree { transition: border-color .12s var(--ease), background .12s var(--ease); }
      
      /* The one-line status next to Run appears and clears on its own; an instant
         swap draws the eye to the corner it is in. */
      #run-status { transition: opacity .15s var(--ease); }
      #run-status:empty { opacity: 0; }
      
      /* One switch for the people the animations cost something: the app has no
         animation that carries information, so none of them has to survive this. */
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *, *::before, *::after {
          animation-duration: .001ms !important;
          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
          transition-duration: .001ms !important;
        }
      }

      .brand-text { min-width: 0; }
      .brand-text h1 { font-size: 15px; }
      #sub {
        color: var(--muted);
        font-size: 12px;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        max-width: 46vw;
      }
      .chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }
      /* These are buttons, so they are drawn as buttons: a real edge, a raised face
         and a press. The pill shape they used to have read as a status badge, which
         is why "Path" and "Check for updates" looked like labels you could not click. */
      .chip {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 6px 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
        background: linear-gradient(var(--panel), var(--panel-2));
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23, 24, 15, .10), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .5) inset;
        font-size: 12px;

        max-width: 30vw;
      }
      .chip:hover:not(:disabled) {
        border-color: var(--accent);
        color: var(--accent);
        background: var(--accent-soft);
      }
      .chip:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; }
      .chip .label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
      /* The branch chip is information, not an action: flat, and it stays that way. */
      .chip.plain {
        cursor: default;
        border-color: var(--rule);
        background: none;
        box-shadow: none;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--muted);

      .chip.plain:active { transform: none; }

        height: 7px;
        border-radius: 50%;

        flex: none;
      }
      .chip[data-tone="ok"] .dot { background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(35, 98, 74, .14); }
      .chip[data-tone="warn"] .dot { background: var(--warn); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138, 90, 0, .14); }
      .chip[data-tone="bad"] .dot { background: var(--bad); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(163, 37, 27, .14); }
      
      /* -------------------------------------------------------------------- tabs -- */
      .tabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: 2px;
        padding: 0 14px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
        background: var(--panel);
      }
      .tab {

        padding: 9px 12px 8px;

        margin-bottom: -1px;

      }
      .tab:hover:not(:disabled) { background: none; color: var(--ink); }
      .tab.is-active { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
